mapper.insert: insert into ticket_order(order_no, scenic_id, user_id, visit_date, timeslot_id, total_amount_cent, status) values(#{orderNo}, #{scenicId}, #{userId}, #{visitDate}, #{timeslotId}, #{totalAmountCent}, #{status})
mapper.select: select * from ticket_order where order_no = #{orderNo} limit 1
select * from ticket_order where order_no = #{orderNo} limit 1 for update
select * from ticket_order where order_no = #{orderNo} and user_id=#{userId} limit 1
select * from ticket_order where id=#{id} limit 1
select * from ticket_order where id=#{id} limit 1 for update
select id from ticket_order where status='UNPAID' and created_at <= #{cutoff} order by id asc

select o.*, i.ticket_name as ticket_name, t.image_url as ticket_image_url from ticket_order o left join ticket_order_item i on i.id = (select min(i2.id) from ticket_order_item i2 where i2.order_id = o.id) left join ticket t on t.id = i.ticket_id where o.user_id=#{userId} and o.status != 'DELETED' order by o.id desc

select o.*, i.ticket_name as ticket_name, t.image_url as ticket_image_url, u.phone as user_phone, u.nickname as user_nickname, u.full_name as user_full_name, u.id_card_no as user_id_card_no from ticket_order o left join ticket_order_item i on i.id = (select min(i2.id) from ticket_order_item i2 where i2.order_id = o.id) left join ticket t on t.id = i.ticket_id left join user_account u on u.id = o.user_id where 1=1 and o.status = #{status} and o.status != 'DELETED' and u.phone like concat('%', #{userPhone}, '%') and o.visit_date = #{visitDate} and o.created_at >= #{createdAfter} and o.created_at <= #{createdBefore} order by o.id desc
mapper.update: update ticket_order set status=#{toStatus}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update ticket_order set status=#{toStatus}, close_reason=#{closeReason}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update ticket_order set visit_date=#{visitDate}, timeslot_id=#{timeslotId}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
